hero.title: Connecting Workers
hero.description: KaamSetu connects skilled workers with genuine opportunities across construction, electrical, plumbing, home services and more.

howItWorks.title: Simple. Fast. Effective.
howItWorks.description: Whether you're looking for work or looking to hire, KaamSetu makes it happen in three simple steps.
howItWorks.wStep1Desc: Add your skills, experience, location, and availability in minutes.
howItWorks.wStep2Desc: Browse jobs matched to your skills and location with smart filtering.
howItWorks.wStep3Desc: Apply with one click, chat with employers, and start earning.
howItWorks.eStep1Desc: Describe what you need, set budget, location, and required skills.
howItWorks.eStep2Desc: See ranked applicants matched by skill, location, and rating.
howItWorks.eStep3Desc: Accept the best fit, communicate directly, and rate after completion.

categories.title: Find Work in Your Trade
categories.description: From skilled trades to domestic help — opportunities across every sector.

benefits.title: Built for India's Workforce
benefits.b1Desc: Jobs are matched by proximity. Find work within walking/commuting distance from your home.
benefits.b2Desc: Apply to jobs in one tap. No lengthy forms, no cover letters required — just your profile.
benefits.b3Desc: Worker profiles are verified. Employer ratings are transparent. Build trust on both sides.
benefits.b4Desc: Our transparent scoring explains exactly why you're a 92% match — skill, distance, availability.
benefits.b5Desc: Add your skills, get discovered. Workers with rare skills appear in front of relevant employers.
benefits.b6Desc: Designed for women returning to work, students, and anyone seeking flexible opportunities.

trust.title: Your Safety is Our Priority
trust.t1: Worker profiles are manually verified by our team
trust.t2: Employer ratings and reviews are transparent
trust.t3: All communications happen within the platform
trust.cardDesc: We verify worker identities, skills, and backgrounds so employers can hire with confidence.

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.description: Join thousands of workers and employers already using KaamSetu.
